question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

A vicious cycle

options.text: When one problem causes another problem

solution: The correct answer is **"When one problem causes another problem."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • A vicious cycle refers to a situation where one problem leads to another problem, which then leads back to the first problem, creating a never-ending cycle. (दुष्चक्र एक ऐसी स्थिति को संदर्भित करता है जहां एक समस्या दूसरी समस्या की ओर ले जाती है, जो फिर पहली समस्या की ओर ले जाती है, जिससे एक कभी न खत्म होने वाला चक्र बनता है) • The term can be used in various contexts, such as economics, health, and social issues. • **Example:** *Poverty can lead to poor education, which then leads to limited job opportunities, which then leads back to poverty.* • The phrase can also be used in a negative sense, implying a harmful cycle that is difficult to break. • The correct answer is Option 1. 33:T64f, The correct answer is **"because the neighbours will complain."**
